# Dinn

AI token workspace, starting with Pons on Robinhood Chain. Public agent services offer live Pons token research, wallet balances, launch options and route quotes. No agent signing or broadcasting endpoint.

- Agent guide: /agent-guide.md
- Manifest: /.well-known/dinn.json
- Service input schemas: /api/agent/schema
- JSON requests: POST /api/agent/request
- Product tools: /api/tools
- Product status: /api/status

The agent endpoint is a free public preview. NEAR Agent Market integration is not yet live. Wallet addresses are explicit query targets, not proof of ownership. Missing fields, unavailable data and provider failures remain explicit. Research responses include a dated evidence artifact; its content hash is not proof of payment or authorization.

The human app separately supports wallet-approved Pons launches, fee claims, Robinhood transfers, Base/Arbitrum funding into Robinhood and available same-chain swaps. Base/Arbitrum swaps are restricted to ETH, USDC and USDT. DEX Screener submission/payment use external checkout. Ascend and Montra on Elysium remain paused.
